t: What Surface Treatment Database Is All About
title: What Surface Treatment Database Is All About
description: Surfaces decide how materials meet the world: paint stops rust, anodizing hardens aluminum, galvanizing sacrifices zinc to save steel. Preparation is most of the job — coatings fail on dirty or poorly profiled surfaces, never on clean ones. Hot-dip galvanizing (zinc at ~450°C) protects steel for 50+ years; hard anodizing grows aluminum oxide 25-100 microns thick. This database is the complete surface treatment: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
